items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.560% for 8 years on 2022-12-07 for a project in the City of Bellevue, Sandusky County. Commitment: create 150 full-time equivalent employees generating $8,500,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.

Illinois EDGE tax credit agreement executed 12/27/2016. Project location: Chicago. New employee jobs target: 25. Retained employee jobs target: 0. Estimated value of credit: $414,178.00. Located in underserved area: N/A.
